ops.body: OWNERSHIP CORRECTION: canonicalHelperProgram() is a SYNCKIT file (synckit daemon/service.go), not daemonkit's — this task's body mislabeled it. daemonkit's involvement is only whether its StableProgram/CanonicalExecutable staging API generalizes to foreign consumer binaries. USER VERDICT (2026-07-26): fix now, full scope — the synckit implementation lane carries this alongside the session-type fix, weighing (i) stop EvalSymlinks and leave the stable /opt/homebrew/bin/<name> symlink as Program vs (ii) stage the consumer binary via daemonkit's mechanism; if (ii) requires a daemonkit API change the lane checks back, and only then does the release freeze actually break (targeted v0.20.7).
